title: Learning to run a power network with trust
reasoning: The paper's core theme is to design and evaluate AI agents that foster 'trust' with human operators. It explicitly models 'human-AI trust-building mechanisms' through concepts like 'reliability', 'credibility', and 'intimacy' (referencing Charles Green's Trust Equation), which are fundamental components of human-AI ethics and moral considerations in a working relationship. The competition itself evaluates these trust-related aspects.
